text:
Liam: Ping  we're short on reviewers for the docs queue today, rotation shows an unfilled slot 09:00-17:00. Any volunteers to pick up PRs?
Aisha: I can cover the morning chunk until 12:30, but need someone to take the afternoon.
Marta: I can take afternoon starting 13:00. Can someone please tag PRs that need preview sign-off?
rotation-bot: Reminder: docs-review-rotation has an open gap 13:00-17:00. Please claim with `/claim docs-review`
Liam: Thanks. Aisha -> morning, Marta -> afternoon. I'll ping the PR list now.
docs-bot: New PRs awaiting review: #1102 (link fixes), #1103 (SDK snippet), #1104 (migration guide tweak). Netlify previews queued.
Aisha: I'll take #1102 and #1103. Marta, please take #1104.
Marta: Got it. I'll check #1104 once the preview is ready.
docs-bot: Preview build started: https://deploy-preview-1104--docs.redwood-inference.com (status: building)
Aisha: Quick note for reviewers: please prefer squash merges for small docs PRs and add release-note: no when appropriate.
Liam: Also reminder to check linkcheck and search-index changes. Small nav edits need release coordination.
docs-bot: Preview #1103 success (status: success). Linkcheck reported 1 external redirect warning.
Aisha: I fixed the external redirect in a tiny commit and re-ran preview. LGTM assuming CI green.
Aisha: CI green for #1103. Merging now (squash).
Marta: Preview #1104 success. Snippet renders but missing language tag on one code block. Will patch in place.
Marta: Patched and re-ran preview. All green. Merging after 5m hold to let release queue settle.
Liam: Great  thanks everyone for picking up the gap. I'll mark rotation-bot that gap is covered.
rotation-bot: Rotation update recorded: 2026-03-22 09:00-17:00 covered by Aisha, Marta.
Liam: Closing thread. If any post-merge regressions appear, ping #eng-docs immediately.
